audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the already-audited mirror: Level 1, Level 2 and Levels 4-5.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill / Heimerdinger / Shen / Shen and the mirror set heimerdinger__shen to exactly that. Shen's page gave Heimerdinger level 1 outright and Shen levels 4-5 outright.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Skill 5/10, Level 2 -> Shen 6/10, Levels 4-5 -> Skill 5/10, proposed as matched full/content pairs with whys[0] and phases[3].why rewritten so the reasons match the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claimed Spirit's Refuge blocks his empowered W rockets, and never mentioned what his stun does to Stand United.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only, so his turret auto-attacks are eaten while Hextech Micro-Rockets and the turret's pass-through beam are abilities and land through the zone untouched. Separately, Stand United is an interruptible channel on 200/180/160s: a landed CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stun — 11s flat, 970 range — cancels the teleport and strands the ally you were saving.
audit.corrected: Rockets claim removed from wants.you[1], whys[2] and early; the channel-cancel written into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d; Shadow Dash's 600 range and 18s rank-1 cooldown put in phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track CH-2 Grenade' appeared a dozen times with no duration attached.

edits.after: Shadow Dash, 600 range on 18s at rank 1, drags him off the nest and his turrets lose their target.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His three-turret nest is up and UPGRADE!!! can empower any piece of it — commit only in the 11 seconds after his grenade misses.

edits.after: Use Spirit's Refuge to block his turret auto-attacks — the beam and Micro-Rockets pass straight through it

edits.before: At Level 1 Heimerdinger drops an H-28G turret and immediately starts winning the CS trade — his turret plus auto-attacks outdamage your Q-empowered autos if you stand in range, so respect the nest and last-hit from the far edge of your Q blade pull. At Level 2, Shadow Dash changes everything: one clean E-taunt pulls him off his turret cluster, and while he is taunted his turrets lose their offensive value because they target you but your Ki Barrier shield absorbs the burst and your Q through the blade deals real damage. At Level 3 with W online you can block his APEX Turret mode or empowered W rockets during the taunt window — the full pattern (E-taunt out of nest, W-block his counterattack, Q through blade) is your bread and butter and it genuinely hurts him if you land it cleanly. Dodge the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade before committing your E or the stun wastes your taunt and you eat the full nest.
edits.after: At Level 1 Heimerdinger drops an H-28G turret and immediately starts winning the CS trade — his turret plus auto-attacks outdamage your Q-empowered autos if you stand in range, so respect the nest and last-hit from the far edge of your Q blade pull. At Level 2, Shadow Dash changes everything: one clean E-taunt pulls him off his turret cluster, and while he is taunted his turrets lose their offensive value because they target you but your Ki Barrier shield absorbs the burst and your Q through the blade deals real damage. At Level 3 with W online you can block his turret auto-attacks during the taunt window, though Micro-Rockets are an ability and land through it — the full pattern (E-taunt out of nest, W-block his counterattack, Q through blade) is your bread and butter if you land it cleanly. Dodge the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade before committing your E, or its 11-second stun wastes your taunt and you eat the full nest.

LEFT ALONE: 'APEX Turret' and 'APEX-mode' appear in wants.you[1] (now removed there), mid and late; APEX is not a name in Riot's kit data, so I removed it only where I was already editing and did not invent a replacement elsewhere. whys[3] and spikes[3].text write the ult as 'UPGRADE!!' with two marks; the real name is 'UPGRADE!!!' with three, but both strings are inside prose I had no other reason to touch and a punctuation-only rewrite risks the length band for no reader benefit — flagging rather than editing.
